fields.summary_ko.0: Micron Technology (NASDAQ:MU) rose 175% in 2026 but fell 35% from June highs, with median Wall Street analyst price target of $1,575 among 55 analysts implying 107% upside from current $760.
fields.summary_ko.1: AI infrastructure demand expected to drive DRAM and NAND prices up fourfold this year, with Q4 revenue surging 379% to $54.2B, though high cyclicality of memory chips remains investor concern.
fields.summary_ko.2: Micron currently trades at 10x earnings with 65% annual earnings growth expected through 2028, but conservative valuation warranted given past supply glut cycle concerns.
